deck.log: Day nine. The drill log is signed by someone who is still in cold sleep.
We voted. Six to three. The three are not on this list any more.
Hold temperature is up again and nobody will say the obvious thing.
If you are reading this, do not open the hold. That is the whole entry.
My pod cycled twice last night. I did not set it to.
Assay will bill us for the assay. That is the joke I have been making.
It came up in the concentrate. It was not in the concentrate for long.
Thirty-one hours to the relay and every hour of it is ours alone.
I keep hearing the vent fans stop when I stop walking.
